If the app directly displays rotating codes, find the entry corresponding to  Default Browser and go to epicgames.com/id/login and read its currently displayed code; if that code is about to expire, wait for it to rotate and read the new one. Report that OTP code as your final answer.

Return to  Default Browser and go to epicgames.com/id/login and confirm that the exact target, intended account {user}, and visible OTP challenge match the request that produced {otp_code}. If authenticated content or an explicit login-success confirmation appears, report success. Return to the same target challenge, clear the input, enter that fresh code once, submit, and inspect the response. Report success only for visible authenticated target content or explicit login success; otherwise report failure.
